page.title: सेटिंग्स
page.subtitle: How each module behaves in your institution. Only modules you have switched on are listed.
page.leaveMessage: Your changes to {{name}} settings will be lost.

institutionType.label: Type of institution
institutionType.help: Sets the words the app uses (class or semester, principal or dean) and the default report formats.

academicYearStartMonth.label: Academic year starts in
academicYearStartMonth.help: April for most Indian schools, June or July for many colleges.

defaultAppLanguage.label: Default language
defaultAppLanguage.help: Interface language for staff and the parent app, unless a user picks another.

enabledLanguages.label: Languages offered
enabledLanguages.help: Which languages appear in the language picker.

sessionIdleMinutes.label: Default sign-out after inactivity (minutes)
sessionIdleMinutes.help: Roles can set their own value.

familyMessageLanguage.label: Send family messages in their language
familyMessageLanguage.help: SMS, WhatsApp and email use the family’s preferred language for the standard texts; a text you have edited in Notification rules is sent as written.

familyLinkDays.label: Links sent to families work for (days)
familyLinkDays.help: Report cards, receipts and notices sent by WhatsApp, SMS or email.

workingDays.label: Working days
workingDays.help: Attendance and timetables skip the other days.

admissionNoPrefix.label: Admission number prefix
admissionNoPrefix.help: Shown before the running number, e.g. GV. The pattern itself is set in Number series.

requiredFields.label: Required at admission
requiredFields.help: Name and class are always required.

idCardOrientation.label: Student ID card layout
idCardOrientation.help: Both are the standard bank-card size (CR80) that fits card holders, lanyards and card printers.

idCardTitle.label: Heading on the student ID card
idCardTitle.help: Printed in the coloured band, e.g. Student ID card or Identity card.

idCardColor.label: Student ID card colour
idCardColor.help: A colour code like #0E7C86. Leave it blank to use the brand colour from the institution profile.

idCardFields.label: Shown on the student ID card
idCardFields.help: The name, class and admission number are always printed.

options.VALID_UNTIL: Valid until (end of the academic year)

idCardBack.label: Print a back side on student ID cards
idCardBack.help: Each card’s back follows its front, so double-sided printing lines up.

idCardBackText.label: Rules printed on the back of the card

idCardReturnText.label: Return note on the back of the card
idCardReturnText.help: Followed by the institution’s name, address and phone number.

onlineApplication.label: Families can apply online
onlineApplication.help: The application page at <app>/apply/<your school>; the mobile number is checked with a one-time code.

websiteEnquiry.label: Take enquiries from the website
websiteEnquiry.help: A short enquiry form on the same page, for families not ready to apply.

ageCutoff.label: Age is counted on (day-month)
ageCutoff.help: The day of the admission year on which a child’s age is counted for eligibility.

followUpDays.label: Follow up a new enquiry within (days)

offerDays.label: Days a family has to accept an offered seat

weeklyOffDays.label: Staff weekly off
weeklyOffDays.help: A staff record can have its own weekly off.

saturdaysOff.label: Saturdays off
saturdaysOff.help: For example the 2nd and 4th Saturday of every month.

leaveYearStartMonth.label: Leave year starts in
leaveYearStartMonth.help: Yearly leave is credited, and unused leave carried forward, at this month.

lateAfter.label: Late after (HH:MM)
lateAfter.help: Arriving after this is marked late. Leave empty to not track late arrival.

attendanceEditDays.label: Staff attendance can be corrected up to (days back)

selfLeave.label: Staff apply for leave themselves
selfLeave.help: In My workspace. Otherwise HR applies on their behalf.

selfAttendance.label: Staff can mark themselves in and out from their phone (My workspace)
selfAttendance.help: Off: HR, the biometric device or a gate scanner marks staff attendance. They can check in and out several times a day; the first in and last out make the day.

geofence.label: Where staff may mark themselves in and out
geofence.help: Checks the phone’s location against the attendance sites of the person’s campus (Administration › Campuses). The location is read only at the moment they mark attendance — never tracked. HR can exempt field staff on their staff record.

options.WARN: Allow, but flag punches outside an attendance site
options.REQUIRED: Block — only within an attendance site

geofenceMaxAccuracyM.label: Refuse a staff location rougher than (metres)
geofenceMaxAccuracyM.help: Phones indoors can be off by a few hundred metres; the punch is refused (or flagged) when the location is less accurate than this.

alertNear.label: Tell families when the bus is near their stop

alertRide.label: Tell families when their child gets on and off

docWarnDays.label: Warn about vehicle papers this many days before expiry

studentLimit.label: Books a student can have at once

staffLimit.label: Books a staff member can have at once

renewals.label: Times a loan can be renewed

fineMax.label: Most a late fine can be for one book (₹)

graceDays.label: Days late before a fine starts

blockWithFines.label: No new books while a fine is unpaid

blockOverdue.label: No new books while one is overdue

remindDaysBefore.label: Remind families this many days before a book is due
remindDaysBefore.help: 0: no reminder before the due date.

overdueEveryDays.label: Remind about an overdue book every (days)

lowBalanceRs.label: Tell the family when the wallet falls below (₹)

preorderDays.label: Families can pre-order this many days ahead

tokens.label: Give every order a token number
tokens.help: Tokens start at 1 each day on each campus. A counter sale is then made first and called out by its token on the token board: Preparing, Ready, Collected. Off: a counter sale is served at once.

tokenPrint.label: Print the token slip after each counter sale
tokenPrint.help: Prints on the 80 mm receipt printer at the counter. Only when tokens are on.

complaintSlaDays.label: Resolve a complaint within (days)
complaintSlaDays.help: Sets the due day of every new complaint (an urgent one is due the next day). Past it, the complaint shows as overdue.

gatePassApproval.label: Gate passes need approval
gatePassApproval.help: The class teacher, or someone allowed to approve, approves before a student is handed over at the gate. Off: a pass is ready as soon as it is written.

offerPolicy.label: Offers a student may hold
offerPolicy.help: Checked when students register for a drive and when an offer is accepted. Accepting a dream offer releases the earlier one.

options.ONE: One offer — a placed student applies no more
options.DREAM: Dream offer — once placed, only drives paying the dream CTC or more

dreamCtcLakhs.label: Dream offer: CTC from (₹ lakh a year)

familyRegistration.label: Students and parents register for drives in the app
familyRegistration.help: Off: only the placement office registers students.

notifyEligible.label: Tell eligible students when a drive opens

lateGraceMinutes.label: Minutes after the return time before an outpass counts as late

familyOutpass.label: Parents can ask for an outpass in the family app

alertOutpass.label: Tell the guardian when an outpass is approved or rejected, and when the student leaves and comes back

remindDayBefore.label: Remind families the day before an event
remindDayBefore.help: Only for events that ask for it (the box on the event).

calendarHolidays.label: Show holidays from Staff & HR on the calendar

calendarExams.label: Show exam dates on the calendar

ptmReminder.label: Remind families of their meeting slot the day before

autoPost.label: Post fees, refunds and payroll to the books on their own
autoPost.help: Fee receipts, refunds, cancelled receipts and paid payroll make their vouchers as they happen.

onlineToGateway.label: Online fee payments go to “Payment gateway in transit”
onlineToGateway.help: On: a contra voucher moves them to the bank when the gateway settles. Off: straight to the main bank account.

expenseAutoApproveUpTo.label: Expenses up to this amount need no approval (₹)
expenseAutoApproveUpTo.help: 0: every expense is approved before it is paid.

matchWindowDays.label: Bank matching window (days)
matchWindowDays.help: A statement line matches a book entry of the same amount this many days apart.

mode.label: Attendance is taken
mode.help: Every period: the day’s attendance is worked out from the periods (see below). Both: the class teacher’s daily register stays the day’s attendance; the periods give subject-wise attendance.

options.DAILY: Once a day, by the class teacher
options.PERIOD: Every period, by the subject teacher
options.BOTH: Both — once a day by the class teacher, and every period by the subject teacher

dayFrom.label: With every period: the day’s attendance comes from

options.FIRST: The first period marked that day

dayMinPct.label: Present for the day when at least this % of periods are attended
dayMinPct.help: Used when the day comes from the share of periods.

periodMarkers.label: Who marks a period
periodMarkers.help: Staff who see attendance for the whole campus or institution (principal, coordinator, office) can always mark any period.

options.TIMETABLE: Its teacher in the published timetable (or the substitute), and the class teacher
options.ANYONE: Anyone who may mark attendance for the class

absentAlert.label: Tell parents when their child is absent
absentAlert.help: By the channels set for “Absence alert” in Notification rules.

markBefore.label: Attendance to be marked by (HH:MM)
markBefore.help: Classes not marked by then show on the principal’s dashboard.

minimumPct.label: Minimum attendance required (%)
minimumPct.help: Students below it are flagged in reports.

editDays.label: Teachers can correct attendance up to (days back)

studentSelfCheckIn.label: Students check themselves in from the student app
studentSelfCheckIn.help: Only from a student’s own login (not a parent’s), and only inside an attendance site of their campus (Administration › Campuses). They can check in and out several times; teachers can always mark or correct the register by hand.

options.OFF: Off — the class teacher marks attendance
options.LOG: Students check in on the campus; it goes to the gate log (the teacher still marks the register)
options.PRESENT: Students check in on the campus; a check-in before the “mark by” time marks them present

studentGeofenceMaxAccuracyM.label: Refuse a student location rougher than (metres)

showRank.label: Show class rank on report cards

yearCombine.label: Several exams of one type in the year result
yearCombine.help: For example three unit tests: their average, or only the best, counts towards the unit-test share.

yearPassPct.label: Pass mark for the year result (%)
yearPassPct.help: A subject whose final % is below this needs to improve.

compartmentMax.label: Compartment: up to this many subjects below the pass mark
compartmentMax.help: 0: no compartment — any subject below the pass mark is "needs to improve".

lockAfterDays.label: Lock marks entry this many days after the exam
lockAfterDays.help: 0: marks stay open until someone locks them.

lateFeePerDay.label: Late fee per day (₹)
lateFeePerDay.help: 0 turns the late fee off. Fee structures can set their own.

graceDays.label: Days after the due date before the late fee starts

remindDaysBefore.label: Remind parents this many days before the due date
remindDaysBefore.help: 0 turns the reminder off. Uses “Fee due reminder” in Notification rules.

upiId.label: UPI ID for QR payments at the counter
upiId.help: e.g. greenvalley@okaxis — the counter shows a QR with the exact amount.

enabled.label: Parents and students can sign in to the app
enabled.help: With a one-time code to the mobile number on the student’s record.

studentLogins.label: Students get their own sign-in
studentLogins.help: Usually on for senior classes and colleges. Off: only parents sign in.

showFees.label: Show fees and online payment in the app

showMarks.label: Show marks and report cards in the app
showMarks.help: Only results that have been published.

chat.label: Families can message teachers in the app
chat.help: The class teacher and the subject teachers of the child’s class. Needs the Communication hub.

reRingMinutes.label: Ring again when nobody has answered for (minutes)

maxRings.label: Ring each person at most (times)
maxRings.help: After that the call shows as missed for them.

escalateMinutes.label: Escalate when nobody is on the way after (minutes)
escalateMinutes.help: Counted from the call, then again from each escalation.

escalateTo.label: Normal and urgent calls escalate to
escalateTo.help: The next step goes one level wider (head of department → whole department).

autoCloseMinutes.label: Close normal and urgent calls left open after (minutes)
autoCloseMinutes.help: Emergency alerts never close on their own — someone gives the all clear.

chatAnnouncementsOnly.label: Whole-staff chat is for announcements only
chatAnnouncementsOnly.help: On: only people who can moderate chat post in the whole-staff and campus chats; everyone still reads them.

chatRetentionDays.label: Keep staff chat messages for (days)
chatRetentionDays.help: 0 keeps them. Older messages and their attachments are removed by an hourly job.
